title: Event Subscription Diagnostic Info
description: Schema defining the response for event subscription diagnostics, including details about processed and unprocessed events.

enabled.description: Whether the alert is enabled. A disabled alert is not running: it reads and sends no events until it is enabled again, and then it starts from the latest event.

latestOffset.description: The latest offset of the event in the system.

currentOffset.description: The offset the event subscription has read up to, as stored. A disabled alert keeps the offset where it stopped; it does not read from there when enabled again.

startingOffset.description: The initial offset of the event subscription when it started processing, as stored.

hasProcessedAllEvents.description: Whether no events are left that the alert will still process. Always true for a disabled alert.

successfulEventsCount.description: Count of successful events for specific alert.

failedEventsCount.description: Count of failed events for specific alert.

relevantUnprocessedEventsCount.description: The number of unprocessed events the alert will still process and its filtering rules let through. Always 0 for a disabled alert.

relevantUnprocessedEventsCountIsLowerBou.description: True when more events are unread than one request evaluates, so relevantUnprocessedEventsCount counts only the first unread events.

totalUnprocessedEventsCount.description: The total number of unprocessed events the alert will still read. Always 0 for a disabled alert.

relevantUnprocessedEventsList.description: A list of relevant unprocessed events based on the alert's filtering criteria. Empty for a disabled alert.

totalUnprocessedEventsList.description: A list of all unprocessed events. Empty for a disabled alert.
